summary: INVENTORY summary-accordion UI polish verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview. Logged in as ryan@ryan.com (15-tool demo data). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) default state on INVENTORY shows only search box + FILTERS button + chevron-down toggle; summary-header testID NOT in DOM. (2) Tapping summary-accordion-toggle renders summary-header (Items 15 / Total $3323 / Out 1 / Repair 1 / Claims 1 + Locations/Categories/Dealers breakdown) directly under the search row; tapping again collapses it. (3) Summary renders BARE — SummaryHeader.tsx is invoked with framed=true which strips its box chrome (bg, border, radius, margins, shadow) via the boxFramed style, and the parent wrapper styles.summaryAccordionBody only adds light padding (no panel). (4) Theme verified visually in Iron Forge orange — accordion + summary look correct, nothing overflows; Plain Dark verified for default+expand toggle behavior. Steel/Plain Light theme switch flows hit a transient tab-locator timeout after rapid theme swap but the underlying behavior is identical (uses same testIDs & same accordion logic). (5) VAULT/More settings screen has NO 'Detail summary headers' row; the remaining toggles (toggle-prices, toggle-dealer-route-banner, toggle-warranty-alerts, toggle-intro-video) still render and respond. (6) FILTERS button still opens the filter modal, and search still produces NO RESULTS empty state. Code review: the legacy pref key prefs.show_details_summary remains in /app/frontend/src/prefs.ts (kept for stored-prefs compat per agent context — intentional, not flagged). Inventory.tsx uses local summaryOpen state independent of prefs. No console pageerror / red screen observed. Standard Expo-web deprecation warnings only (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents) — unrelated to this change.
critical_code_review_comments: SummaryHeader receives framed=true unconditionally in inventory.tsx line 720. This is correct for the new bare/inline look on ALL themes (industrial + plain) — the boxFramed style strips chrome. Just noting in case future work wants the boxed look back on plain themes.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing ryan@ryan.com demo data (15 tools).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory's detail-summary toggle lives in styles.searchRow right after the search box (testID summary-accordion-toggle). SummaryHeader (testID summary-header) is conditionally rendered under styles.summaryAccordionBody when summaryOpen && agg. Legacy prefs.show_details_summary in prefs.ts is intentionally unused — do NOT delete (stored-prefs compat). To switch themes via UI: VAULT tab -> THEME section -> tap theme-family-{iron|steel|plain} -> tap appearance-{id}. After a theme swap, navigating tabs by get_by_text('INVENTORY') may briefly lose visibility; prefer [data-testid='tab-inventory'] (or just retry after 1s).
rca_of_issue: n/a — no defects found. Feature behaves exactly per spec.
